overviewParagraphs: Heron Lake Golf Course is one of Northern Vietnam's most naturally integrated playing experiences — a resort layout that respects and incorporates the region's native wetland ecosystem rather than fighting against it. Herons, egrets, and wildlife are constant companions throughout the round.

Designed by Brian Curley (Schmidt-Curley Design), the course flows seamlessly through the natural landscape with strategic water features and mature tree corridors framing each hole. The greens are undulating and receptive, rewarding approach shots hit with precision and appropriate trajectory.

Located within easy reach of Hanoi, Heron Lake is an excellent choice for the discerning golfer who wants a peaceful, countryside round in contrast to the busier resort circuits. Its combination of natural beauty and solid course design consistently earns it high marks from visiting internationals.

curatorBriefHtml: Heron Lake Golf Course is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Hanoi, Vietnam, crafted by Pacific Coast Design (2010) and stretching to 6,971 Yards across a natural wetlands and lake environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its natural wildlife & wetlands integration (Habitat for native wild herons) and strategic water hazard placement (Water in play on 14 holes).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Heron Lake Golf Course (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie local familiarity & line reading (Helps avoid hidden lake bays), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Hanoi golf tour by AGS, Heron Lake Golf Course provides a distinct architectural test by Pacific Coast Design that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

scorecard.verdict: A peaceful resort layout that blends harmoniously into the Heron Lake wetlands. Native water birds, palm-lined fairways, and strategic water hazards reward thoughtful shot placement.
